notes.title: The caves update live now!
notes.content:
Everyone!

After a lot of hard work, the new free content update, The Caves, is now live!

In this update there is a whole new area that can be accessed from the very start of the game. It includes a whole new challenge with new traps and a new enemy type. Also included in this update is a new ranged attack type that can be unlocked through a secret. There is also a new outfit that can be unlocked after defeating the boss in the Caves.

To access the caves, simply roll through the small tunnel that was created at the start of the game.

Here is the full changelog:

- Added the caves optional area
- Added The Dark Blade outfit
- Added Getsuga attack
- Added ghost type enemy
- Added new trap
- Fixed strange bug in the upgrade menu that double purchased upgrades
- Added a couple new decorations in earlier areas

Thank you to everyone playing this game, your support means a lot to me!

Also please don't forget to leave a review!

notes.title: Free Content Update Coming Soon
notes.content:
Everyone!

I know I haven't been working on this game for awhile, I've been busy with a new project. However, I decided to put that on hold for now to bring new content to this game. A whole new area with new platforming challenges and more lore. 

This new area is called "The Cave". It is a secret optional area that can be accessed at the very beginning of the game. In this area you will find previously unused traps and enemies, more upgrades to help with the main areas, new boss(es), and even a new outfit.

I don't have a release date for this yet, however my estimate is within 2023. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Quick patch
notes.content:
Just found some unnoticed bugs from the previous update and fixed them.

Here's the list of changes:

- Fixed player health not loading the first time someone plays the game.

- Fixed boss music bug.

- Adjusted enemy recovery time after getting hit from 0.5f to 0.8f

- Adjusted player stamina regen rate from 220 to 250

I'm planning something a bit bigger for the next update so stay tuned.

notes.title: Save & Quit update
notes.content:
I know not many people play this game but I still want to work as hard as I can to make this game as great as it can be. Based on some player feedback I have added a new function, save & quit.

Now players can save their progress from the main menu before quitting the game and return to it later. However death still means a reset. This function was supposed to be added at launch but it was extremely complicated (a lot more complicated than I was expecting) having to save so many different variables and then loading them. It took a lot of work but I finally managed to add it, I also fixed another overlooked keyboard bug and also adjusted the recovery time for enemies when they get hurt.

Here's the full list of changes:

- Save & Quit function added

- fixed roll & backstep controls for keyboard

- enemy recovery time after getting hit has been reduced to 0.5f from 1f

To everyone who plays this game and enjoys it I want to thank you for playing and I will continue to support this game as best I can.

Thank you,
Studio Jubei's only member

Edit: I have just became aware of a new bug that only occurs when starting the game for the first time. The player's health is not properly set causing the player's starting health to be 0 however to fix this simply die and then hit continue, then the health will be set properly. I have a fix for this but its too small a bug to fix on its own, it will be added in the next update.

notes.title: Quick patch
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I'm sorry about this previous update adding controller support. I made a mistake when coding the interactions and forgot to check to make sure that keyboard still works while only focusing on controller. I am very sorry to the people who were playing the game after the update but I hope most of you were not.

The list of changes are very minimal since this was a quick patch.

- Fixed major keyboard interactions bug.

This game will not work properly on mouse and keyboard without this patch and will not only break the game but also give some spoilers for the lore.

Thank you,
Studio Jubei

notes.title: First update
notes.content:
Just a few days after launch and based off of responses from the community the first update is live.

First you should know that its very likely that your death and kill counters will be reset along with saved settings. Hopefully that is not a huge deal for everyone.

Here's a complete list of changes in Lost Oath's first update:

- Fixed bug where the Ronin boss didn't die properly.

- Added control scheme in the main menu

- Added partial controller support.

The main thing here is the new controller support. The player can now be fully controlled using any Gamepad controller however for now you will still need a mouse to navigate menus.

I hope all of you have enjoyed the game so far and I hope these changes make the game better for all of you.

Thank you.
